primary.definition: For each seed and rule, [(all_or_nothing live−silent)−(partial live−silent)] on correct executed-pair rate; subtract update0, trapezoid-integrate over six checkpoints /6000, then average strict and reciprocal.

primary.name: mean_payoff_communication_interaction_centered_pair_rate_time_AUC
primary.scope: Pair labels are researcher-side unique-plan targets. This is an adaptive partner-selection statistic, not a language or compositionality score.
primary.unit: Probability difference averaged over training time; multiply by100 for percentage points.

scope.boundary: Partner adaptivity and communication gains are behavioral task measures. They do not establish word meanings, compositionality, intergenerational transmission, or human language origin.
scope.inference: Four-seed developmental pilot; no confirmatory interval or automatic continuation.
scope.input: Completed aggregate JSON plus passed read-only physical replay audit.
scope.primary: For each seed and rule, [(all_or_nothing live−silent)−(partial live−silent)] on correct executed-pair rate; subtract update0, trapezoid-integrate over six checkpoints /6000, then average strict and reciprocal.
scope.semantics: Correct executed pair is matched to the researcher-side unique full-plan pair; all worlds remain in the denominator.
